description: This file contains server-side logic for the SignUpPage in an online examination system. It handles page load, user registration, and navigation to login, including saving user details and uploading images to the server.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for handling user registration, image uploading, and navigation for the sign-up webpage.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the login page when the login button is clicked.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Handles user registration: saves uploaded image, inserts user data into the database, and navigates to the login page upon success.
